naslov: Short clip from the lecture (6/6) — December 12, 2025

segmenti.tekst: نَوِّرْ قَلْبِي بِالْقُرْآنِ، وَاشْرَحْ صَدْرِي بِالْإِيمَانِ، وَاغْفِرْ ذَنْبِي يَا رَحْمَٰنُ، … يَا مَنَّانُ
segmenti.prevod: Illuminate my heart with the Qur’an, open my chest with faith, forgive my sin, O Most Merciful, … O Bestower of favours! (supplication; a part near the end was not clearly recognised)
